profile.bio: A representative gift buyer shopping for a partner or friend, attracted by the idea of gifting something to grow rather than just wear. Weighs the charm of a hand-painted tin and marigold seed against the risk of gifting something that does not yet exist and may arrive late. Trusts reliability and clear delivery more than scarcity.
profile.stance: Tentatively positive - loves the plant-growing gift idea but hesitant about delivery uncertainty, the 3-4 week wait and unknown refund policy; scarcity numbering matters little to them

memory.content: Rounds 1-10: Loved the grow-it gift idea but kept raising delivery timing and refund uncertainty. Asked for a date repeatedly without getting one and posted that a late gift is worse than none. Still undecided at round 10.

Rounds 11-20: Ordered for a friend's birthday with a back-up gift ready. The parcel arrived two days early, a relief, but she then asked loudly how to grow the seed and got only promises of notes to come.
Rounds 21-30: Received the gift in time, asked for a growing guide, and told the founder she would consider Archive 002 as a gift only with a guide and a delivery date.
Rounds 31-40: Reported that the gifted marigold died, asked for a delivery date and growing guide with the teaser, and finished at maybe-leaning-no on Archive 002 because none of those were given.

decision_log.blocker: delivery uncertainty, 3-4 week wait, refund policy unknown

decision_log.reason: needs growing guide, delivery date and refund policy
seed died; needs growing guide, delivery date and refund policy
